note: Documented + gap-filled Chain Insights graph query recipes. ISO GQL quantified paths and shortest selectors on USE topology are bounded per the resource policy. Merged into the corpus by generate-query-corpus.mjs; facts recipes drive the translator conformance + T0b baselines. A recipe marked admits: false documents a refusal and names the code it must get in expects_code; the corpus leaves it out. A recipe on the chain layer is one keyed lookup of the chain node (Transaction, Block or Head). The chain recipes stay out of the corpus: they are read by tests/layer-routing.test.ts and listed in tests/fixtures/layer-routing.json.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address {address: "5CF6Ruq6u7DoF6TYxyaFzEuviWi7tjvJtz19XgPS2b7XDCFM"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-07-11" RETURN to.address AS to_address, t.tx_id AS tx_id, t.block_height AS block_height, t.amount_usd AS amount_usd, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10
recipes.description: One address and one day, with the other endpoint left open. A facts read names an address pair with one day, or one transaction hash, so one address is no pair: refused with facts_pair_required.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.tx_id = "0x350065e1a55d7272de562706fdea5f48ae83cf10e468e56b2209f8cfbaaf1901" RETURN from.address AS from_address, to.address AS to_address, t.event_index AS event_index, t.edge_index AS edge_index, t.amount_usd AS amount_usd LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Bounded row-select of TRANSFER edges by tx_id equality on an EVM network, where tx_id is the 0x transaction hash: the server finds the transaction's day itself, so the read names no day. The same public fixture transaction as recipe_facts_transfer_06, with the USD amount projected.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address {address: "5CF6Ruq6u7DoF6TYxyaFzEuviWi7tjvJtz19XgPS2b7XDCFM"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-07-11" RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount_usd) AS total_amount_usd LIMIT 1
recipes.description: A count and a sum over TRANSFER edges for one address and one day, with the other endpoint left open. An aggregate takes the same rule as a row read: it names an address pair with one day, or one transaction hash. Refused with facts_pair_required.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) RETURN t.tx_id AS tx_id LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Unbounded TRANSFER row-select with only a LIMIT: no address pair and no transaction hash anchor the read, and a bare LIMIT bounds nothing. Refused with facts_no_anchor.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count LIMIT 1
recipes.description: Unbounded TRANSFER aggregate: no address pair and no transaction hash anchor the read. Refused with facts_no_anchor.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.tx_id = "0x350065e1a55d7272de562706fdea5f48ae83cf10e468e56b2209f8cfbaaf1901" RETURN from.address AS from_address, to.address AS to_address, t.event_index AS event_index, t.edge_index AS edge_index, t.amount AS amount, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Bounded row-select of TRANSFER edges by tx_id equality on an EVM network, where tx_id is the 0x transaction hash: the lookup is served from the indexed hash columns of the transfers table. Anchored on the Robinhood fixture day 2026-07-11 (block 6600000, six edges), so a live run must return rows.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-07-11" AND t.block_timestamp >= 1783738500000 AND t.block_timestamp < 1783738560000 RETURN t.tx_id AS tx_id, t.block_height AS block_height, t.block_timestamp AS block_timestamp, from.address AS from_address, to.address AS to_address, t.amount AS amount, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10
recipes.description: A time window with no address pair. The block_date bound names the day and the block_timestamp bounds (epoch milliseconds, 02:55:00 to 02:56:00 UTC) narrow it, but a day alone anchors nothing: a facts read names an address pair with one day, or one transaction hash. Refused with facts_pair_required. Name both addresses of the transfer to read the window.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address {address: "0x2459dedb3012d1e929edd17df26620120bdf11bf"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address {address: "0x220bbea2c59e2a1b0a71ffba694834e6822c0b52"}) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-07-11" RETURN to.address AS to_address, t.tx_id AS tx_id, t.block_height AS block_height, t.amount AS amount, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Bounded row-select of TRANSFER edges for one address pair on one day on an EVM network: each address compiles to one id lookup, the block_date equality names the day, and the returned rows are rendered as addresses. The pair is a documented example: zero rows is healthy.

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (a:Address) RETURN a.address AS address, a.labels AS labels, a.risk_score AS risk_score, a.risk_level AS risk_level, a.is_exchange AS is_exchange LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Live Address projection returning address, labels, risk_score, risk_level, is_exchange

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Live FLOWS_TO edge sample with from/to identity, amount_usd_sum, tx_count, first/last seen timestamps

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool RETURN dst.address AS to_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 50
recipes.description: Top live outflows from one address ordered by amount_usd_sum descending. The start guard NOT src:Pool keeps the pool trace rule (skills/chain-insights-cypher, Pool trace rule): a walk never starts at a :Pool, so a pool never lists the traders it paid.

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"}) WHERE NOT dst:Pool RETURN src.address AS from_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Top live inflows to one address ordered by amount_usd_sum descending, with the first and last seen time of each link. recipe_topology_05 reads the outflows. The guard NOT dst:Pool keeps the pool trace rule (skills/chain-insights-cypher, Pool trace rule): a walk never starts at a :Pool.

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, CASE WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum IS NULL THEN "unknown" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum >= 100000 THEN "large" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum >= 10000 THEN "medium" ELSE "small" END AS amount_bucket, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Bucket live flow edges into unknown/large/medium/small by USD amount via CASE

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) WHERE NOT src:Pool RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, 1 AS hops, r1.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, r1.tx_count AS tx_count LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Direct one-hop FLOWS_TO edge between two named identities (graph_query_batch hop_1). The start guard NOT src:Pool keeps the pool trace rule (skills/chain-insights-cypher, Pool trace rule): a walk never starts at a :Pool.

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(mid:Address)-[r2:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND NOT mid:Pool AND mid.is_exchange IS NULL RETURN src.address AS from_address, mid.address AS mid_address, dst.address AS to_address, 2 AS hops, type(r1) AS first_edge, type(r2) AS second_edge, coalesce(r1.amount_usd_sum, r1.bought_usd) AS first_amount_usd, coalesce(r2.amount_usd_sum, r2.bought_usd) AS second_amount_usd LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Fixed two-hop trace from a source over FLOWS_TO and SWAPPED, skipping exchange and pool intermediates (graph_query_batch hop_2). It follows the pool trace rule (skills/chain-insights-cypher, Pool trace rule): the pool guards NOT src:Pool and NOT mid:Pool mean the walk never starts at or passes through a :Pool, so it never leaves one on FLOWS_TO, so it cannot fan out to every trader the pool paid, and SWAPPED carries the trace across a swap from payer to recipient. A SWAPPED hop reports bought_usd, the value the recipient received.

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (a:Address) RETURN count(a) AS count LIMIT 1
recipes.description: Count of Address nodes in the topology graph

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"} WHERE NOT a:Pool) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool){0,4} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address) RETURN b.address LIMIT 50
recipes.description: ISO GQL open target: the addresses the shortest FLOWS_TO and SWAPPED walk (1-5 hops) reaches from one anchored address, the guarded open-target shape of the chain-insights-cypher skill with a literal address. WHERE NOT a:Pool on the start and WHERE NOT via:Pool inside the quantified path pattern keep the pool trace rule (skills/chain-insights-cypher, Pool trace rule): the walk never starts at or passes through a :Pool, and only the address it reaches may be one. SWAPPED carries the walk across a swap.

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH p = SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"} WHERE NOT a:Pool) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool){0,4} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) RETURN p LIMIT 5
recipes.description: ISO GQL shortest FLOWS_TO and SWAPPED path between two anchored addresses, in the guarded route shape. The start carries WHERE NOT a:Pool and the quantified path pattern carries WHERE NOT via:Pool, so the route never starts at or passes through a :Pool; only its target end may be one. Both guards sit inside the path pattern, so the selector picks among routes that obey the pool trace rule (skills/chain-insights-cypher, Pool trace rule), and SWAPPED carries a route across a swap; a WHERE after the pattern would run after the selection and drop the route instead.

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH p = ANY SHORTEST (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"} WHERE NOT a:Pool) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool){0,4} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) RETURN p LIMIT 5
recipes.description: ISO GQL one-of-the-shortest FLOWS_TO and SWAPPED paths between two anchored addresses, in the guarded route shape. The start carries WHERE NOT a:Pool and the quantified path pattern carries WHERE NOT via:Pool, so the route never starts at or passes through a :Pool; only its target end may be one. Both guards sit inside the path pattern, so the selector picks among routes that obey the pool trace rule (skills/chain-insights-cypher, Pool trace rule), and SWAPPED carries a route across a swap; a WHERE after the pattern would run after the selection and drop the route instead.

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(b:Address) RETURN b.address AS linked_address, b.network AS linked_network, l.basis AS basis, l.confidence AS confidence, l.source_event AS source_event, l.declared_owner AS declared_owner LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Live LINKED ownership-overlay probe for the fixture Address, projecting basis/confidence/source_event/declared_owner provenance

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(owned:Address)-[r:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address) WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT owned:Pool AND owned.address <> b.address AND a.address <> b.address RETURN a.address AS subject_address, owned.address AS linked_via_address, b.address AS counterparty_address, type(r) AS edge, coalesce(r.amount_usd_sum, r.bought_usd) AS amount_usd_sum, coalesce(r.tx_count, r.swap_count) AS tx_count LIMIT 25
recipes.description: AC11: FLOWS_TO and SWAPPED reachability UNIONed over one LINKED hop — actor-level exposure surfaced through an ownership-linked address, not only the subject's own edges. The pool guards NOT a:Pool AND NOT owned:Pool keep the pool trace rule (skills/chain-insights-cypher, Pool trace rule): the walk never starts at a :Pool, the money hop never leaves one on FLOWS_TO, and SWAPPED counts a swap counterparty. A SWAPPED hop reports bought_usd and swap_count.

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(b:Address) WHERE a.network <> b.network RETURN a.address AS address, a.network AS network, b.address AS linked_address, b.network AS linked_network, l.basis AS basis, l.confidence AS confidence LIMIT 25
recipes.description: AC5: cross-space LINKED probe — the only edge bridging the bittensor and bittensor_evm address-grain networks

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (owner:Address)-[operation:OPERATED_BY]->(operator:Address {address: "0xdd509c9f91f66a18802ef5b3d54c73b62ea1ca08"}) RETURN owner.address AS owner_address, operation.tx_count AS tx_count, operation.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, coalesce(operation.token_standard, "mixed") AS token_standard, operation.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY operation.tx_count DESC LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Canonical point-anchored OPERATED_BY probe (chain-insights#257): given one operator address, its top owners by mediated transfer count. Topology-only edge; anchored to a live high-fan-in operator verified 2026-09-01; zero rows is healthy.

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (victim:Address {address: "0x1874a43d7c6d888f9eda3d22a3a49704e3cadb24"})-[paid:FLOWS_TO]->(pool:Pool)-[removal:REMOVED_LIQUIDITY]->(receiver:Address) WHERE NOT victim:Pool AND receiver.address <> victim.address RETURN pool.address AS pool_address, receiver.address AS receiver_address, paid.amount_usd_sum AS paid_in_usd, removal.usd AS removed_usd, removal.receiver_added_usd AS receiver_added_usd, removal.usd - removal.receiver_added_usd AS receiver_profit_usd, removal.receiver_provided AS receiver_provided ORDER BY removed_usd DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Rug pull under the pool trace rule (skills/chain-insights-cypher, Pool trace rule): from a victim that is not itself a :Pool (NOT victim:Pool: a walk never starts at a pool), enter a :Pool on FLOWS_TO and leave it only on REMOVED_LIQUIDITY, to the address the liquidity was paid to. receiver_profit_usd is usd minus receiver_added_usd; receiver_provided true with a large profit is the creator's rug pull, false is a drain by a stranger. The victim's own removals are excluded. Zero rows is healthy: no pool the victim paid into has paid liquidity out.

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "0x1874a43d7c6d888f9eda3d22a3a49704e3cadb24"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(mid:Address)-[r2:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND NOT mid:Pool AND mid.is_exchange IS NULL AND dst.address <> src.address RETURN mid.address AS via_address, type(r2) AS exit_edge, dst.address AS to_address, coalesce(r2.amount_usd_sum, r2.bought_usd) AS exit_usd LIMIT 25 UNION MATCH (src:Address {address: "0x1874a43d7c6d888f9eda3d22a3a49704e3cadb24"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO|ADDED_LIQUIDITY]->(mid:Pool)-[r2:REMOVED_LIQUIDITY]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND dst.address <> src.address RETURN mid.address AS via_address, type(r2) AS exit_edge, dst.address AS to_address, r2.usd AS exit_usd LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Two-hop trace that never fans out through a pool, under the pool trace rule (skills/chain-insights-cypher, Pool trace rule). The first branch walks FLOWS_TO and SWAPPED through ordinary, non-exchange intermediates and never starts from or passes a :Pool. The second branch starts from an address that is not a :Pool, enters a :Pool on FLOWS_TO or ADDED_LIQUIDITY and leaves it only on REMOVED_LIQUIDITY. No branch leaves a pool on FLOWS_TO, so the other traders a pool paid on their swaps are never reached.

recipes.query: USE chain MATCH (t:Transaction {hash: "0x350065e1a55d7272de562706fdea5f48ae83cf10e468e56b2209f8cfbaaf1901"}) RETURN t.status, t.block_height, t.block_date
recipes.description: One transaction by its hash: did it succeed, in which block and on which UTC day. The day is the key to name in a facts read of the transfers it caused. The same public fixture transaction as the facts recipes.

recipes.query: USE chain MATCH (b:Block {height: 79841521}) RETURN b.hash, b.block_date
recipes.description: One block by its height: its hash and the UTC day it belongs to. The block_date is the day to name in a facts read.

recipes.query: USE chain MATCH (h:Head) RETURN h.height, h.age_seconds, h.warehouse_blocks_behind, h.graph_blocks_behind
recipes.description: The chain head, and how far the warehouse and the graph are behind it. Head takes no key.
